_purpose: T6 at lambda = 1, the setting the published work studies most and the one where the disagreement in print actually sits. [T25] reports the transition as continuous at 160 points with the full rule; the first author's own thesis says that above three connections it 'appears to become first-order'. Those are not obviously about the same thing, and nobody we have read has run both this and lambda = 0 in one code at matched sizes and asked how the barrier grows with size. That comparison is the whole point of running the control first. Lambda = 1 is also the exact tie described in section 9 of the write-up: the shattered state and the flat sheet cost precisely the same energy here, so nothing opposes the symmetry term - which is a separate reason this setting is worth measuring rather than assuming. Everything except lambda and the coupling ladder is IDENTICAL to t6_lam0_control, for the matched-sensitivity reason given in t6_lam125.json.
name: t6_lam1
